_universe: Every ASX listing is scanned each morning, then filtered to shares a $10k account can actually trade.
_setup: Opening range breakout on 'stocks in play' (Zarattini, Barbon & Aziz 2024; Toby Crabel).
_risk: Defence first (Paul Tudor Jones): small fixed risk, hard stops, daily loss limit.
_timing: Sydney time. Morning momentum only; flat before the close.
_learning: Rules added from losses, plus an end-of-day review that adapts slowly and only on evidence.
_costs: Modelled on a low-cost online broker plus slippage from trading on 20-minute delayed data.
